item.description: Trading partners have responded to the latest US tariff plans with a mix of disappointment and protests, while some hold out the prospect for negotiations. Bloomberg's North Asia correspondent Minmin Low says China and the EU have made it clear that they will retaliate if necessary. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.description: Strong winds ripped the roof off a building in Maryland, as an extreme storm began to move up the East Coast on Thanksgiving morning.

item.title: Review: Gold Steadies as Fed Rate Path and AI Stocks Frame Volatile Week
item.description: Gold steadied, as traders weighed the prospect of Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes against a wider market recovery spurred by a rebound in US technology stocks.

item.title: Review: ‘Dollar Storm:’ Greenback on Track for Longest Winning Run Since 2024
item.description: The dollar is poised for its longest monthly winning streak in two years as a rupture in the artificial intelligence trade and rising interest rates spur demand for safe-haven assets.
